_about: Network expectations from static inspection of baseline channels-to-network.py. Input is a collected_chats.csv; only username, counter, and source are read. Edges point from each source channel to the chat it mentions; the graph is a directed, unweighted nx.DiGraph, so repeated observations and duplicate rows collapse into one edge. Phase 3 consumes these.

collection_batch.input: collected_chats.csv produced by the collection 'batch' scenario (tests/fixtures/expected/collection.json)

no_edges.legacy: crash: pd.concat([]) raises ValueError('No objects to concatenate')
no_edges.intended_fix: Phase 3: write an empty Graph.gexf and an empty network.png

equal_degree.legacy: crash: normalize_values divides by zero when every node has the same degree
equal_degree.intended_fix: Phase 3: use one finite constant node size

compatibility: matplotlib 3.11 removed matplotlib.cm.get_cmap; Phase 3 must switch to matplotlib.colormaps[...] (behavior-preserving).
